Market Problem

A multi-billion dollar problem.
Zero structural solutions.

The burnout market has generated massive investment, and virtually none of it addresses the actual source of the problem.

Human Sustainability Vendors

$61B+ market

Treats burnout as an individual issue disconnected from leadership architecture risk. Mindfulness apps, EAPs, resilience trainings. All downstream.

✗None of it changes the structure producing the exhaustion.

Traditional HR Consulting

$37B+ market

Engagement surveys, pulse checks, policy recommendations. Measures symptoms without structural diagnosis.

✗Output is a report. Not recalibration.

Culture & Sustainability Programs

$9.3B market

Valuable but typically siloed. Addresses inclusion and support without diagnosing leadership architecture risk.

✗People feel seen. Still burned out.

Strategic Transformations fixes the design.

The only practitioner-developed framework that treats burnout as a structural failure and delivers a diagnostic and recalibration pathway that addresses it at the root - not downstream, not symptomatic.

The Solution

One methodology, tested in community,
monetized at scale.

ST is often read as two brands: a corporate structural-diagnostics consultancy, and a faith-grounded formation practice for women of color leaders. They are one R&D pipeline. URI Formation and the UNMASK community are where the framework is tested against real, high-stakes lived experience - the population most exposed to structural strain and least served by existing burnout solutions. The corporate consulting arm, the diagnostic instruments, and the enterprise licensing pipeline are where that tested intelligence is converted into a measurable, sellable product. The community isn't a separate audience to manage around the corporate voice. It's the validation source the corporate voice is built on.

The UNMASK Framework

A diagnostic and recalibration methodology that identifies hidden strains - the "masks" individuals, institutions, and communities wear under systemic pressure - and rebuilds authentic leadership capacity. Developed through direct organizational consulting and grounded in Womanist theology.

Seed Capital

What this capital actually unlocks.

ST is early-stage and founder-funded to date. The methodology is proven, documented, and generating revenue. What's missing is not validation, it's access: the operating capital to reach the networks, markets, and licensing infrastructure that turn a working practice into a scalable one.

This raise moves ST from founder-powered to infrastructure-powered.

  • →Market and network access — conference circuit, enterprise pipeline development, warm-intro capital ST cannot self-fund at current stage
  • →Licensing infrastructure — the legal, IP-protection, and platform buildout required to license the four instruments and UNMASK Recalibrate at scale
  • →Certification pathway — the training and quality-control infrastructure that lets certified practitioners deliver the methodology, reducing dependence on the founder's personal calendar
  • →Product buildout — UNMASK SaaS platform, AI-enhanced diagnostics integrated into the existing agent stack

What we're looking for in a capital partner.

✓Alignment with the liberation-grounded vision, not just the financials
✓Understanding that justice-centered frameworks are the future of organizational health
✓Patient capital that supports a build designed for scale, not a quick exit
✓Connections and relationships in the enterprise, nonprofit, and academic markets
✓Respect for the founder's intellectual authority and methodological sovereignty

Strategic Transformations is not looking for investors who want to change the vision. We are looking for investors who understand what it is, and want to build it with us.
